registered: before running; no funding or volatility statistics of the listing events were looked at; reference v9.6 3.161 [2.775, 3.919, 2.576] (live-timing version 3.169 reported)

trials.A inverse-vol sizing: size per event = 0.05 x clip(2.0 / vol24, 0.5, 2), vol24 = annualised sd of the hourly returns over the 24 hours before the entry midnight (decided at entry; 2.0 = 200% a year, fixed in advance)
trials.B skip crowded shorts: skip an event when the mean funding rate of the settlements in the 24 hours before the entry midnight is below -0.0005 per 8 hours (rate scaled to 8 hours by the settlement interval; shorts already crowded and paying)

rest: as the v9.6 listing short (scripts/listing_live.py): 30 days, 30% stop, gross cap 0.5, 10 bp, funding
pass: strict rule vs v9.6 (research reference); with several passes the highest 2022-26 Sharpe
